what: Proposed self-validate jq uses strict .schema_version == "1" while dispatcher shell check accepts jq -r stringification of numeric 1
scenario_or_breakage: Implementer writes "schema_version": 1 (JSON number); prompt jq -e fails and blocks rename; dispatcher [[ "$SCHEMA_VERSION" != "1" ]] passes after jq -r → false-negative self-validation and unnecessary rewrite loops
suggested_fix: Align predicate with dispatcher: e.g. ((.schema_version | tostring) == "1") or document string-only and add the same rule to the shell SCHEMA_VERSION gate at skills/implement/scripts/step2-implement.sh:486-487
